interfaces.name: mate
interfaces.what: the face an EHR-3 housing (part:jst-ehr-03, or either end of part:cable-dxl-x3p) plugs onto. Posts at x = -2.5000, 0.0000, +2.5000 (A = 5.0 = 2 x 2.5), square 0.64, rising 3.3 above the 0.9 wafer floor (Type A post, eEH.pdf p.4 Note 2). The mated housing's board-facing face lands 1.6000 above the board: (8.1) mated assembly height on p.2 minus the housing's 6.5 height on p.3 — connection:jst-eh-3pin's seating datum.
